page.content:
Land walls that kept Constantinople for a millennium.

How Theodosian Walls connects

  • Location: Constantinople — The Theodosian Walls guarded the city's land side.
  • Event: Fall of Constantinople — Ottoman guns broke the Theodosian land walls.

What is Theodosian Walls?

The Theodosian Walls guarded the city's land approach. They held through sieges until Ottoman cannon and the 1453 assault finally broke the defense.

Key threads lead to Constantinople and Fall of Constantinople.
